dedupe_keys.name: dynamic responses of submerged components in advanced reactors

description: Dynamic responses of submerged components in advanced reactors is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Whittaker, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). A set of experiments was executed on a 6-degree-of-freedom earthquake simulator to generate data that could support validation of numerical models for seismic fluid-structure interaction (FSI) of submerged components. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Fluid–structure interaction, shake table tests, submerged components, added mass, seismic response, reactor internals. Published 2023-01-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
